description: This file defines a package 'operator' responsible for managing devices in a test or deployment environment, including device registration, deregistration, messaging, and proxying. It provides structures such as Device, preDevice, and DevicePool, along with associated methods to handle device lifecycle and communication.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with its associated data, connection, proxy, and client management.

classes.name: preDevice
classes.description: Holds information about a device between pre-registration and registration.

classes.name: DevicePool
classes.description: Manages the collection of pre-registered and registered devices.

methods.name: newDevice
methods.description: Creates a new Device instance, sets up proxy and assigns group ID.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the device via its connection.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a client to the device, returning a client ID.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a client from the device.

methods.name: DisconnectClients
methods.description: Notifies all registered clients that the device has disconnected.

methods.name: ToClient
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific client associated with the device.

methods.name: NewDevicePool
methods.description: Constructs a new, empty device pool.

methods.name: GetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a registered device by ID.

methods.name: GroupIds
methods.description: Lists all registered device group IDs.

methods.name: GetDeviceDescList
methods.description: Gets a list of device descriptors for all registered devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceDescByGroupId
methods.description: Gets a list of device descriptors filtered by group ID.
